## Overview

Follow-up to #62761 for the Kimi-K3 interactive recipe on GB200 and GB300. It changes only `recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml`.

**Draft: depends on vllm-project/recipes#1159.** That PR adds the `decode_context_parallel` schema field and the builder row; this YAML fails the renderer's schema check until it merges and the renderer pin updates. I will mark this ready then.

## Claims

- **Draft backend:** The GB200 and GB300 `spec_decoding` toggle now emits `"attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA"` inside `--speculative-config`. The other speculative settings are unchanged, and the top-level `--attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA` still configures only the target model. B200, B300, AMD and Ascend are unchanged; TOKENSPEED_MLA on the draft was only run on GB200/GB300 in InferenceX [#3748](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3748), [#4047](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4047) and [#4322](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4322).
- **DCP selector:** Opts into the new **Decode context parallel** row with sizes 8 and 16 on GB200/GB300, `a2a` comm backend and `match_tp: true`. A size is offered only when it equals the TP of every role, the layouts InferenceX qualified: GB200 TP8 x PP2 aggregated is DCP8 (#4322), TP16 per role disaggregated is DCP16 (#3748, #4322), GB300 TP8 pools are DCP8 (#4047). These are reference configurations, not universal defaults.
- **Side effect:** A TP1 DEP decode pool on GB200/GB300 used to render `--decode-context-parallel-size 16`, which vLLM rejects; it now drops the flag. A mixed-TP disaggregated layout shows no row.
- The guide's DCP bullet describes the row. Per-concurrency settings and CUDA graph sizes stay in the static GB200 sections.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <checkout>/recipes` passes against the renderer from vllm-project/recipes#1159.
- Rendered in headless Chrome: GB200 aggregated TP8/PP2 shows DCP8, GB200 disaggregated TP16 shows DCP16 on both roles, Off removes both DCP flags, GB300 disaggregated shows DCP8, B200 shows no row. The spec-decoding JSON on GB200/GB300 carries the draft backend and is unchanged on B200.
- Not done: a full variant x hardware render diff, and a live hardware-switch click-through.

---

@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ meta:
   provider: "Moonshot AI"
   description: "Pre-release 2.8T-parameter native multimodal MoE with Kimi Delta Attention, Gated MLA, Attention Residuals, and a 1M-token context window"
   date_added: 2026-07-27
-  date_updated: 2026-10-20
+  date_updated: 2026-10-21
   tasks:
     - multimodal
     - text
@@ -82,6 +82,18 @@ features:
           - "128"
           - "--speculative-config"
           - '{"model":"RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark", "num_speculative_tokens":8, "method": "dspark", "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "rejection_sample_method": "block"}'
+      # GB200/GB300 run the draft on the target's TOKENSPEED_MLA backend, as the
+      # InferenceX AgentX lanes do (#3748, #4047, #4322); the top-level
+      # --attention-backend configures only the target model. The other
+      # speculative settings are the generic DSpark draft's.
+      gb200:
+        args:
+          - "--speculative-config"
+          - '{"model":"RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark", "num_speculative_tokens":8, "method": "dspark", "attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA", "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "rejection_sample_method": "block"}'
+      gb300:
+        args:
+          - "--speculative-config"
+          - '{"model":"RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark", "num_speculative_tokens":8, "method": "dspark", "attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA", "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "rejection_sample_method": "block"}'
       npu:
         args:
           - "--speculative-config"
@@ -123,6 +135,17 @@ features:
           VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER: "0"
           VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER: "0"
 
+# DCP size selector, qualified on GB200/GB300 only. A size is offered when it
+# equals the tensor-parallel size of every role: TP8/PP2 aggregated -> DCP8
+# (InferenceX #4322), TP16 per disaggregated role -> DCP16 (#4322), TP8 GB300
+# pools -> DCP8 (#4047) and TP16 aggregated -> DCP16 (low-latency profile).
+decode_context_parallel:
+  sizes:
+    gb200: [8, 16]
+    gb300: [8, 16]
+  comm_backend: a2a
+  match_tp: true
+
 opt_in_features:
   - spec_decoding
   - text_only
@@ -745,7 +768,7 @@ guide: |
   - **mlx5 dmabuf registration failures**: if engine init fails with "NCCL error: unhandled system error" and the log shows `mlx5dv_reg_dmabuf_mr` errno 524, the kernel/driver lacks mlx5 dmabuf support (NCCL 2.28 registers dmabuf by default). Set `NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE=0` to fall back to `nvidia_peermem` (must be loaded on the nodes) — still GPUDirect RDMA.
   - **FP8 KV**: If FP8 KV cache is needed, please also add `--attention-config '{"use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"mla_prefill_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA"}'` when serving vLLM. `TOKENSPEED_MLA` is what the Blackwell profile above emits (paired with `--attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA` for decode), but it is not the only supported choice: vLLM 0.27.1 registers three MLA prefill backends — `FLASHINFER`, `TRTLLM_RAGGED` and `TOKENSPEED_MLA` (see `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/prefill/registry.py`) — and any of them may be substituted for `mla_prefill_backend` alongside `use_prefill_query_quantization`. Which one wins depends on the input-length distribution, so benchmark before switching. Those backends do not run on ROCm: on MI355X the builder pairs FP8 KV with `--attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}'` instead.
   - **Prefix-match unit**: K3 is a hybrid model: its MLA attention layers and KDA (Mamba-like) layers form two KV-cache groups under the hybrid KV-cache manager. With prefix caching on, vLLM pads the attention block size up to match the Mamba state page, so both groups resolve to one (large) block size and the default prefix-cache hit boundary lands on that block — very coarse. The Blackwell profile sets `--prefix-match-unit 128`: the inflation formula always yields a multiple of 128, so 128 divides whatever block size results, and it aligns with the MLA kernel's native block boundary, giving finer prefix-hit granularity. The value is only effective when prefix caching (or a KV connector) is active; it is a no-op otherwise, and it is safe under all tensor-parallel layouts.
-  - **Decode context parallelism (DCP)**: enable the **Decode context parallelism** opt-in feature in the command builder to shard the decode KV cache across the tensor-parallel ranks for decode-heavy long-context serving. It emits `--decode-context-parallel-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA` with `mla_prefill_backend: TRTLLM_RAGGED` (on MI355X: `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA` with `mla_prefill_backend: ROCM_AITER_FA`), and is scoped to the TP8 single-node profile because the DCP size must divide the tensor-parallel size. On builds that carry them, the `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A`, `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER` and `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER` knobs default to auto and turn the direct DCP ops on where applicable; set them to `1` only to pin that path explicitly, or `0` to disable it. The MI355X DCP option sets all three to `0`, as InferenceX does.
+  - **Decode context parallelism (DCP)**: enable the **Decode context parallelism** opt-in feature in the command builder to shard the decode KV cache across the tensor-parallel ranks for decode-heavy long-context serving. It emits `--decode-context-parallel-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA` with `mla_prefill_backend: TRTLLM_RAGGED` (on MI355X: `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA` with `mla_prefill_backend: ROCM_AITER_FA`), and is scoped to the TP8 single-node profile because the DCP size must divide the tensor-parallel size. On builds that carry them, the `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A`, `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER` and `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER` knobs default to auto and turn the direct DCP ops on where applicable; set them to `1` only to pin that path explicitly, or `0` to disable it. The MI355X DCP option sets all three to `0`, as InferenceX does. On GB200 and GB300 the builder's **Decode context parallel** row (Off, DCP8, DCP16) sets `--decode-context-parallel-size` on every node tab and, under Prefill/Decode, on both roles. It offers only the size equal to the tensor-parallel size of every role, the layouts InferenceX qualified: GB200 TP8 x PP2 aggregated is DCP8 (#4322), TP16 per role disaggregated is DCP16 (#3748, #4322), and GB300 TP8 pools are DCP8 (#4047). Other layouts, such as a TP1 DEP decode pool, show no DCP row and drop the flag.
   - Ascend W4A8 checkpoint (ModelScope): https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Kimi-K3-w4a8
   - vLLM Ascend tutorial: https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/v0.23.0/tutorials/models/Kimi-K3.html
